title: Evaluation on the sign cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates with sign-valued leaves. For every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, evaluating $T$ on the binary vector obtained by applying the inverse binary-to-sign correspondence coordinatewise gives the same value as evaluating the associated Boolean function of $T$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: decision tree on $n$ coordinates with sign-valued leaves
